title: Desparkening
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

entities.name: The Desparkening
entities.description: A process that caused most planeswalkers to lose their sparks after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which the Desparkening began.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: Space between planes planeswalkers could no longer enter.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Former planeswalker who theorizes the sparks were moved, not destroyed.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Speculated the Multiverse was trying to heal itself.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Planeswalker who detonated the Filigree Sylex within the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: Dimensional researcher who theorizes the Omenpaths caused the Desparkening.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who gifted his spark to Tamira on dying.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: First attested planeswalker to ignite after the Desparkening.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Sacrificed the spark inherited from Venser to un-compleat Ajani and Nissa.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker whose spark was encased in a hedron and lost when it shattered.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon whose Elderspell removed sparks lethally.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Involved in the New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths opened across the Multiverse allowing travel for all.

entities.name: Filigree Sylex
entities.description: Device Elspeth detonated within the Blind Eternities.

events.summary: The Desparkening begins after the New Phyrexian Invasion, leaving most planeswalkers without sparks.
events.quote: The Desparkening began after the New Phyrexian Invasion in 4562 AR .

events.summary: Desparked planeswalkers are trapped on their current planes, while Omenpaths open across the Multiverse.
events.quote: Planeswalkers that lost their sparks were subsequently trapped on their current plane.

events.summary: Jace Beleren dies and gifts his spark to Tamira, who becomes the first to ignite after the Desparkening.
events.quote: When Jace Beleren died, he gifted his planeswalker spark to Tamira

events.summary: Karn sacrifices his spark to un-compleat Ajani and Nissa.
events.quote: Karn sacrificed the spark he inherited from Venser to un-compleat Ajani Goldmane and Nissa Revane .

events.summary: Nahiri's spark, encased in a hedron after un-compleation, is lost when the hedron shatters.
events.quote: but it was lost when the hedron shattered.
